snippet.title: Hidden around the World - Teaser
snippet.description:
✨ Hidden Around the World!

Travel across beautifully hand-drawn cities inspired by real places like Tokyo, Paris, New York, and more.

Find hidden objects, complete relaxing missions, and decorate charming scenes full of life and color.

It’s a warm, slow-paced experience made for players who love exploration, details, and cozy vibes 🌸

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3995480/Hidden_around_the_World/
